concept: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights
summary: Source-anchored research for Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Atlas queryShapeHash identifies the newer query shape used for query statistics; it is distinct from planCacheShapeHash, formerly queryHash. Do not equate these identifiers when correlating observability data with plan-cache diagnostics. (medium confidence)

On MongoDB 8.x, Atlas collects at most 100 reads per second per host and excludes writes; on 9.0+, its default is random sampling of 1% of reads and writes. Values describe collected operations, so upgrades can change totals without workload changes. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Datadog query-shape metrics expose samplingstrategy and samplingrate. The rate_limited strategy reports samplingrate=0; sampled collection uses a fraction such as 0.01 for 1%. Zero therefore must not be interpreted as a random sample fraction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

A local-shard $lookup can increment foreign-collection namespace latency and operation counts without generating a foreign-collection slow-query log. SERVER-98528 documents this observability mismatch and attaches a reproducer. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-98528

Datadog exports query-shape metrics under the mongodb.atlas.querystats prefix, including execution counts, documents examined and working time. In the Atlas Administration API, queryShapeHash is the identifier for a query shape (a SHA256 hash also output by $queryStats, $explain and slow query logs), and Query Shape Insights identifies shapes by hash for users without PII access. Sources: https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2025-03-12/operation/operation-listgroupclusterqueryshapeinsightsummaries ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md

Query Shape Insights groups structurally similar operations and ranks shapes by total execution time; Namespace Insights compares collection-level latency. Together they locate expensive workload patterns and affected collections. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md
Query Shape Insights requires dedicated M10+ clusters running MongoDB 8.0+. The documented window is seven days, with up to five shapes charted together. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Namespace-level metrics support comparing affected collections: Namespace Insights charts up to five namespaces and shows total latency, average latency, percentile latency and operation count per collection. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md

Namespace Insights excludes time-series collections and hides collections using Queryable Encryption. Automatically selected top namespaces can change with the time window; missing samples may be interpolated and drawn with dotted lines. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Namespace Insights total latency and operation count are rates. Average latency uses differences in cumulative duration and operation count over a ten-minute interval. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The Query Shape Insights summaries API deprecates P50/P90/P99 execution-time series and fields as potentially inaccurate. SERVER-126327 attributes incorrect percentiles to calculation from lastExecMicros and requests native execution-time histograms; avoid treating those legacy values as reliable distributions. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2025-03-12/operation/operation-listgroupclusterqueryshapeinsightsummaries ; https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-126327

The query shape and namespace dashboards provide host/node, shard and interval filters and expose aggregate query shape or collection statistics. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md

Query Shape Insights requires dedicated Atlas M10+ clusters running MongoDB 8.0 or later. Namespace Insights also requires M10+. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md
Query Shape Insights exposes execution counts, examined/returned document ratios and execution-time trends, with application and driver metadata for workload attribution. (medium confidence)

Query Shape Insights helps identify expensive query shapes and provides a pivot to Query Profiler with collection and operation-type filters. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-query-shape-insights-in-mongodb-atlas ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md

Displayed query-shape totals represent collected operations. A sampling-policy change during an 8.x-to-9.0 upgrade can change totals without a workload change; infrequent shapes can be absent. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Namespace Insights offers total and average latency, P50/P95/P99 latency, operation counts, and read/write/command filters. Its documented average uses differences in cumulative times and counts over a ten-minute interval. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Query Shape Insights execution time includes getMore processing and excludes client waiting time. Datadog working_millis_sum_total uses milliseconds, while Atlas UI execution-time descriptions use microseconds; normalize units before comparison. (medium confidence) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md ; https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas

The documented Query Shape Insights metric table lists aggregate per-shape statistics (execution time, counts, keys/docs examined and returned, percentiles) and does not include a replanReason metric. The Namespace Insights metric list (total, average, P50/P95/P99 latency, operation count) likewise does not include replanReason. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md
